items.title: Five insight views on one spine
items.body: Summary, Progress, Explore, Readiness and Operate replace fifteen pages. Each view keeps its detail screens in a tab strip, and every page offers Run analysis, Auto clean, Report library, Present and Export.

items.title: Progress since baseline
items.body: Compare any run with the pinned baseline: records fixed, new and still failing, every object's score before and after, the rules that moved most, and a proof-of-progress PDF.

items.title: Fix it or download it, one click each
items.body: A finding now offers Auto clean this rule, which queues every failing record of the rule in this run as a fix batch, next to Download list for manual clean (Excel).

items.title: Explore by any axis
items.body: Pivot the failing rules by object, field, dimension, severity or S/4 status, then save the view and share its link.

items.title: Presentation mode
items.body: Present drops the navigation so any page fills a boardroom screen. Escape brings it back.

items.title: Object history
items.body: Every object page shows its score across all runs, with the change between runs.

items.title: Homes by role
items.body: Each role lands on its own home. Data managers start runs from any insight page.

items.title: Row density that works
items.body: Compact, default and comfortable under Preferences now retune rows, controls, cards, tiles and page spacing. Presentation mode steps type and the hero up a size.

items.title: Process models export to PowerPoint
items.body: Export a discovered L1 to L5 process model as a deck, next to the Signavio package.

items.title: The happy path in conformance
items.body: Conformance now shows the most common route through a process and the share of cases that follow it.

items.title: Live progress on runs and extractions
items.body: The run and extraction pages show a progress bar while the job is running, so you no longer need to refresh.

items.title: Insights and reports
items.body: New executive, forecast, impact and trend pages, with a board PDF and an analyst workbook behind them.

items.title: Rules know what is unmaintained
items.body: A field that nobody fills in is now reported once as not applicable, instead of as one defect per record.

items.title: Skip reasons are specific
items.body: When a rule is skipped, the run says why: missing table, missing field or not applicable to your configuration.

items.title: Rule coverage across the SAP landscape
items.body: Rules now cover the data dictionary for ECC, S/4HANA and the cloud systems, with checks that read the loaded configuration.

items.title: Layout and density
items.body: A tighter layout with a density choice, and a redesigned shell.
